    }
    \draw[fill=gray!10, draw=black!80, line width=1.5pt, rounded corners=3pt] (-4.2, 1.5) -- (4.2, 1.5) -- (3.7, -1.5) -- (-3.7, -1.5) -- cycle;
    \draw[fill=black!85, draw=black, rounded corners=2pt] (-4.0, 1.3) -- (4.0, 1.3) -- (3.5, -1.3) -- (-3.5, -1.3) -- cycle;

    % Pins
    \foreach \x/\lbl in {-3.2/C9, -2.4/C8, -1.6/C7, -0.8/C6, 0.0/C5, 0.8/C4, 1.6/C3, 2.4/C2, 3.2/C1} {
        \draw[fill=yellow!70!orange, draw=orange!90!black, thick] (\x, 0.7) circle (0.18);
        \node[rotate=180, text=white, font=\sffamily\bfseries\tiny] at (\x, 0.7) {\lbl};
    }
    \foreach \x/\lbl in {-3.2/B9, -2.4/B8, -1.6/B7, -0.8/B6, 0.0/B5, 0.8/B4, 1.6/B3, 2.4/B2, 3.2/B1} {
        \draw[fill=yellow!70!orange, draw=orange!90!black, thick] (\x, 0.0) circle (0.18);
        \node[rotate=180, text=white, font=\sffamily\bfseries\tiny] at (\x, 0.0) {\lbl};
    }
    \foreach \x/\lbl in {-2.8/A8, -2.0/A7, -1.2/A6, -0.4/A5, 0.4/A4, 1.2/A3, 2.0/A2, 2.8/A1} {
        \draw[fill=yellow!70!orange, draw=orange!90!black, thick] (\x, -0.7) circle (0.18);
        \node[rotate=180, text=white, font=\sffamily\bfseries\tiny] at (\x, -0.7) {\lbl};
    }
